zh: 起始帐篷支路：从起始帐篷向上一间、向左一间，再向下一间进入竖井。沿气泡走到战斗房，清完敌人后打碎灵魂石像。
下层帐篷支路：在下层帐篷左上方找石像，用弹弓把火柴当落脚点跳上去。交付点就在这座帐篷左边，可以拿完顺路送回鸟巢。
上层帐篷支路：学会悬停后，从上层帐篷向左，经过一小段瞭望塔，从可下落的出口下去并打开门。石像在井口正上方的房间。
打碎石像后记得回下层帐篷左侧的鸟巢交付。交付 2、12、20 个灵魂时可领取饰物奖励。
en: Start tent branch: Go up one room, left one and down one into the shaft. Follow the bubbles to the combat room, clear the enemies and break the spirit statue.

Bottom tent branch: Look just above and left of the bottom tent. Use Slingshot to make a matchstick foothold and jump to the statue. The nest is just left of this tent, so you can return the spirit on the way back.

Top tent branch: After learning Hover, go left from the top tent through a short stretch of Lookout Tower. Take the downward exit and open the gate. The statue is in the room directly above the Well entrance.
After breaking the statues, return the spirits to the nest left of the bottom tent. Trinket rewards are available at 2, 12 and 20 returns.

zh: 生锈叉子：从猎人小屋中央帐篷向左一小段，站到左侧气泡下方，用弹弓把火柴射进右墙。踩气泡从上方绕过去，落到火柴上，再借它弹高拾取。
计时挑战与灵魂：学会悬停后，从中央帐篷往右三间，再向上三间到挑战石像。通过计时后进入奖励房，打碎石像救出灵魂。回夜之庭园的鸟巢交还。
en: Rusty Fork: Go a little left from the central Hunter’s Cabin tent. Stand below the bubble on the left and fire the matchstick into the right wall with Slingshot. Use the bubble to go around from above, drop onto the matchstick and bounce up to the pickup.

Time trial and spirit: After learning Hover, go right three rooms from the central tent, then up three to the trial statue. Finish the trial, enter the reward room and break the statue to free the spirit. Return it to the Night Garden nest.

zh: 发夹：从沼泽右侧帐篷往左一间、向下两间。按出现顺序踩气泡，完成后进入打开的门拿发夹。装备后，8 秒内不攻击，下一击伤害翻倍。
布片：从右侧帐篷往左三间，再向上、向右各一间。踩完依次出现的气泡，等门打开再进去拾取。装备后会小幅提高空中攻击伤害。
饰物槽：从左侧帐篷往上一间，打破左墙。向左用弹弓发射火柴，借火柴弹进气泡，够到饰物槽。
工坊代币：学会悬停后，从上方帐篷往左一间，借气泡弹到高处，再悬停到左侧墙边拾取。
en: Hair Pin: From the right-hand Bog tent, go left one room and down two. Bounce on the bubbles in the order they appear, then collect Hair Pin beyond the door. With it equipped, your next attack deals double damage after eight seconds without attacking.

Scrap of Fabric: From the right-hand tent, go left three rooms, then up one and right one. Finish the bubble sequence and collect it beyond the door. Equipping it slightly increases aerial attack damage.
Trinket slot: From the left-hand tent, go up one room and break the left wall. Fire the matchstick left with Slingshot, then bounce off it into a bubble to reach the slot.
Workshop Token: After learning Hover, go left one room from the upper tent. Bounce high on the bubbles, then hover toward the left wall for the token.

zh: 排水道灵魂：从中央帐篷向右进气流房，按住跳跃乘风升到顶部，再落到左侧平台，打碎灵魂石像。
融化蜡烛：从排水道中央帐篷一直向右，约五间后到有气流和尖刺的房间。用乘风通过，蜡烛在路线末端。装备后，每次治疗完成会获得短暂无敌。
鱼钩：从中央帐篷向左两间，再向上进计时挑战房。带上悬停和无限攀爬回访会更容易。通过计时后继续进开启的奖励房拾取，装备后低血量时会加快焰瓶补充。
en: Drains spirit: Go right from the central tent into the wind shaft. Hold jump to ride the updraft to the top, then land on the platform to the left and break the spirit statue.

Melted Candle: Go right from the central Drains tent until you reach the windy spike room, about five rooms away. Use Wind Ride to cross and collect the candle at the end. Equipping it briefly makes you invulnerable after healing.

Fish Hook: From the central tent, go left two rooms and up to the time trial. Hover and Endless Climb make the return easier. Finish the trial and enter the unlocked reward room to collect it. Equipping it speeds up Flaming Vessel refills at low health.

zh: 墓谷灵魂：从墓谷帐篷往右三间，再往下一间。到房间上层后向左找暗墙，跳进去打碎灵魂石像。
破铃：从墓谷帐篷往左四间，无需额外能力。装备后，焰瓶投空时可补回一瓶。
裂纹弹珠：从帐篷向右两间，再向上、向左、向上各一间。到有临时挡板的机关房后攀到左上角，用弹弓敲铃，趁通路开放时过去拾取。
臼齿：东北角的竖井要从两侧开门。以帐篷为起点，一侧走上两间、右三间，另一侧走右三间、上两间。分别操作拉杆，再进入中间通道拾取。
en: Graven Valley spirit: From the tent, go right three rooms and down one. On the upper part of the room, jump left into the hidden wall and break the spirit statue.
Broken Bell: Go four rooms left from the Graven Valley tent. No extra ability is needed. When equipped, it restores a Flaming Vessel after a missed throw.

Cracked Marble: From the tent, go right twice, then up, left and up. In the room with temporary barriers, climb to the upper-left corner and use Slingshot to ring the bell. Cross while the route is open.

Molar Tooth: Open the northeastern shaft from both sides. From the tent, go up twice and right three times for one lever, then right three times and up twice for the other. Operate both levers and enter the central passage to collect it.

zh: 气泡房的灵魂：从瞭望塔下层帐篷往下再往右，进入气泡挑战房。用悬停调整落点，完成机关后打碎石像。
尖刺岔路的灵魂：先拿齐三枚飞行时长升级。从下层帐篷往左，向上三间到尖刺岔路，再沿右侧通道一直走到底，找到第二处灵魂石像。
同一处尖刺岔路往左可补拿工坊代币。右侧灵魂救出后，回夜之庭园下层帐篷左侧的鸟巢交付。
en: Bubble-room spirit: From the lower Lookout Tower tent, go down and right into the bubble challenge room. Use Hover to adjust your landings, then break the statue after clearing the puzzle.

Spike-fork spirit: Collect all three flight-duration upgrades first. Go left from the lower tent, climb three rooms to the spiked fork and follow the right-hand passage to its end for the second spirit statue.
Take the left branch at the same spike fork for a Workshop Token. After freeing the spirits, return them to the nest left of Night Garden’s lower tent.

zh: 从夜之庭园上层存档点向右，用弹弓借火柴越过尖刺、够到对面的墙。清完敌人后到右上角操作开关，走上方出口。下一处帐篷往左，沿路进入瞭望塔。
踩有羽毛的泡泡即可短暂飞行，头顶的小羽毛是提示。以塔内中央帐篷为基点，分别查帐篷左上、区域最左侧上方和右上三处飞行时长升级。
帐篷左上支路：第一次见到星歌者后，用弹弓把火柴射进右墙，借它跳到上方墙面并爬进顶层房间。向左跳上移动平台，敲转轮往左过关。清掉下一间的敌人，先别走下方出口，向左攀墙取第一枚升级。
远侧左上支路：拿到第一枚后，经下方出口操作回帐篷的捷径开关。向右落回上一间，再从左侧出口借羽毛泡泡飞过尖刺墙。清完左上方的敌人，从右墙攀到上方出口。向左进入下一段尖刺区，接力踩两颗羽毛泡泡，打开返程捷径后从上方离开。看到伊尔达后向右攀墙，清完敌人在房间顶部拿第二枚。
右上支路：从中央帐篷向右，借羽毛泡泡够到上方墙面，再向右清战斗房。敲转轮推动平台穿过移动尖刺柱，过关后先走右门。穿过下一段尖刺后往上，在三岔房用中央平台的羽毛泡泡飞到正上方出口。见到星歌者后向右攀墙，升级在顶部。
三次升级齐全后，回中央帐篷并借羽毛泡泡继续登高。尖刺段用飞行泡泡够到上方两处开关，打开右边出口。下一间敲转轮过移动平台，再攀墙操作开关。向右到第二处帐篷存档，继续向右挑战星歌者。
击败星歌者后向右进下一间，拾取用于开启女王城堡的金色羽毛。
en: Head right from the upper Night Garden save point. Use Slingshot and the matchstick to reach the wall across the spikes. Clear the enemies and hit the switch in the upper-right corner to open the exit above. Go left from the next tent to enter the tower.

Bounce on a feather bubble to fly temporarily. The small feather over your head shows the effect. Use the central tower tent as a base and look for the three duration upgrades above-left of the tent, high on the far left, and in the upper-right area.

Above-left branch: After first meeting Starsinger, use Slingshot on the right wall and bounce to the wall overhead. Climb into the upper room, jump onto the moving platform, and strike the wheel to ride left. Clear the next room and climb the wall on the left for the first upgrade before taking the lower exit.

Far-left branch: After the first upgrade, take the lower exit and open the shortcut to the tent. Drop back into the previous room on the right, then take its left exit and use the feather bubble to get past the spike wall. Clear the enemies above-left and climb the right wall to the upper exit. Go left and use two feather bubbles in succession to cross the next spike section. Open the shortcut and exit upward. From Ilda, climb the wall to the right, clear the enemies and collect the second upgrade at the top.

For the upper-right branch, leave the central tent to the right, use a feather bubble to reach the upper wall and continue right through the combat room. Strike the wheel to move the platform past the spike columns, then take the right door. Cross the next spikes, go up and use the central feather bubble in the three-exit room to reach the top exit. Climb to the right of Starsinger for the upgrade.

With all three upgrades, return to the central tent and use a feather bubble to resume the ascent. Use flight bubbles to hit both upper switches in the spike section and open the right exit. Cross the moving platform by striking its wheel, then climb to the next switch. Save at the second tent and head right to fight Starsinger.
After defeating Starsinger, enter the next room on the right and pick up the Golden Feather for Queen’s Castle.

zh: 以中央帐篷作为回访基点；飞行时长升级和金色羽毛是不同项目。
en: Use the central tent as a return point. Flight-duration upgrades and Golden Feathers are separate items.

zh: 摩天轮旁的灵魂：从秋日森林左侧帐篷向右两间，借摩天轮向上两间，再向左到计时挑战石像。通过计时后进奖励房，击碎灵魂石像。
蘑菇机关后的灵魂：从右侧帐篷往下，再往左。解开蘑菇房后进入下一间，用弹弓让火柴借蘑菇反弹，再用它作落脚点。带上攀爬和悬停，过机关后打碎石像。
两处救出的灵魂都交到夜之庭园下层帐篷左侧的鸟巢。
en: Ferris wheel spirit: Go right two rooms from the left Autumn Forest tent, use the Ferris wheel to go up two rooms, then head left to the time trial statue. Finish the trial, enter the reward room and break the spirit statue.

Mushroom puzzle spirit: From the right tent, go down and left. Solve the mushroom room and enter the next one. Use Slingshot to bounce the matchstick off the mushrooms and use it as a foothold. Bring Climb and Hover, then break the statue beyond the puzzle.
Return both freed spirits to the nest left of the lower Night Garden tent.

zh: 秋日森林入口需要两处开关。夜之庭园侧：从瞭望塔入口前的帐篷往西，清完途中战斗房，再操作开关。开关附近可顺路拿玻璃碎片饰物。
猎人小屋侧：回序章拿食物的房间，用弹弓和悬停够到上方出口。下一间往东到帐篷，再从帐篷向左走到两只移动铁笼处。
站在第一只铁笼上，把火柴从窄缝射向第二只铁笼，借它上到高处。从左边离开，下一间从最左侧的上方出口出去。继续往左操作第二处开关，门开后从上方出口进入秋日森林。
进森林后借蘑菇弹上高处，再向右越过尖刺坑，沿节庆布置继续前进。经过摩天轮时搭到顶部，从上方出口出去。解开第三处石球机关后经过节日帽商贩，继续向西到节庆帐篷。
节庆帐篷西侧封路时，从帐篷旁的下层通道绕行。遇到右侧路障就转左，解开第四处石球机关，继续向左并下砸破开木地板。清理下层敌人，经右侧出口绕到伊尔达烤橡果的篝火。
从篝火向左操作捷径开关，再攀到最上层，从背面打开节庆帐篷旁的路障。回帐篷存档后向西挑战森林之王。战后向右进下一间，与伊尔达交谈并拾取金色羽毛。
同一羽毛房间内，Ilda 右侧隐藏通道有故事书页；先确认攀爬路线。
en: The Autumn Forest gate has two switches. On the Night Garden side, go west from the tent before the Lookout Tower, clear the combat room and activate the switch. You can pick up Glass Shard nearby.

On the Hunter’s Cabin side, return to the room where you took food in the prologue. Use Slingshot and Hover to reach the upper exit. Go east in the next room to the tent, then head left to the two moving cages.

Stand on the first cage and fire the matchstick through the narrow gap into the second. Use it to climb up and exit left. In the next room, take the upper exit at the far left and continue left to the second switch. With the gate open, climb through the top exit into Autumn Forest.

Bounce up on the mushrooms, cross the spike pit to the right and follow the festival decorations. Ride the Ferris wheel up and take the top exit. After the third orb puzzle, pass the festive hat vendor and continue west to the festival tent.

If the route west of the festival tent is blocked, take the passage below it. Turn left at the right-hand barrier, solve the fourth orb puzzle and continue left to slam through the wooden floor. Clear the enemies below and take the right exit to loop around to Ilda’s acorn campfire.

Go left from the campfire to open the shortcut, then climb to the top and open the barrier beside the festival tent from the far side. Save and head west to the Forest King. After the fight, go into the room on the right, speak to Ilda and collect the Golden Feather.
A story page is hidden right of Ilda in the feather room; check the climbing route.

zh: 区域位于地图上方，呈橙色；森林之王场地是主要推进地标。
en: The orange region sits near the top of the map; the Forest King arena is a main landmark.

zh: 机关规则：同一轮让石球碰到全部石柱；落地、撞墙或离开画面会重置。
双柱房：向左或右击球，让它在两根石柱间反弹。参考视频 00:00。
三柱房：把球向右打向地柱，趁球弹起跳过地柱，到右侧第一层平台。球下落时向左打向墙柱，留在平台等球反弹回来。球到顶柱正下方时向上打。参考视频 00:16。
第三处：站在石球右侧，把球向左打到斜蘑菇上。球反弹下落时，借房间中央的蘑菇跳起，在空中把球向右打，瞄准右侧弹性物的左上部。参考视频 00:34。
第四处：先把球向左打到斜蘑菇上。趁它弹向起点上方的顶棚蘑菇，跳上高台等球，再向左击球，让它撞上左侧较高的斜蘑菇。随后跑到石柱左侧，在左边顶棚蘑菇的左侧等球回来，把球打进石柱。参考视频 00:49。
玩偶头支路：先向左击球，立刻用攀爬抢到房间上方。等石球经过顶柱正下方，再向上击打，开门后拾取玩偶头。参考视频 01:12。
en: Hit every pillar in one attempt; floor, wall or off-screen contact resets the orb.
Two-pillar room: send the orb sideways so it rebounds between both pillars. Reference video: 00:00.

Three-pillar room: hit the orb right toward the floor pillar, then jump over it onto the first ledge on the right. Hit the falling orb left toward the wall pillar and stay on the ledge. When it returns beneath the ceiling pillar, strike upward. Reference video: 00:16.

Third room: stand to the right of the orb and hit it left into the slanted mushroom. As the orb drops, bounce off the middle mushroom and strike right in midair, aiming at the upper-left of the right bumper. Reference video: 00:34.

Fourth room: hit left into the slanted mushroom. While the orb rebounds toward the ceiling mushroom above its start, climb onto the upper platform. Strike left again toward the higher slanted mushroom. Move to the left of the pillar, past the left ceiling mushroom, and hit the returning orb into the pillar. Reference video: 00:49.

Doll’s Head branch: hit the orb left, then climb to the upper part of the room before it arrives. Strike upward when it passes directly beneath the pillar, then go through the opened barrier to collect the trinket. Reference video: 01:12.

zh: 从码头船坞的 Barge 处拿到无限攀爬后，传送回沼泽。向左借气泡过水，留意对岸高台的工坊代币。继续往左，到尽头下落。经过像 Glimmer 姐妹的玩偶，再向前进入玩偶师之家。
和玩偶师对话后继续向左，从尽头下到存档帐篷。往下推进时，敲铃升起临时平台。到大锅前清掉刷出的敌人，再向右敲铃下落。
向房屋下层推进，完成玩偶师遭遇后检查西侧的 Magda 与墙壁弹射能力。
本区故事书页包含需要悬停、攀爬或弹射的回访位置。
en: After receiving Endless Climb from Barge at the shipyard, fast-travel to the Bog. Go left and bounce across the water. Look for a Workshop Token on the high platform on the far side, then continue left and drop at the end. Pass the doll resembling Glimmer’s sister to enter the Dollmaker’s House.

Speak to the Dollmaker, then go left and drop to the Save Tent. Ring the bells to raise temporary platforms as you descend. Clear the enemies by the cauldron, then head right and ring the bell to drop down.
Progress into the lower house; after the Dollmaker encounter, check west for Magda and Wall Sling.
Some story-page routes need Hover, Climb or Slingshot on a return visit.

zh: 从下层遭遇位置向西衔接新能力。
en: The new-ability route continues west of the lower encounter.

zh: 学会无限攀爬后，从沼泽帐篷往左，踩气泡过水。继续向左，在尽头下落，走到最左侧拾起长得像玛格达的玩偶，再往前进屋。
与玩偶师交谈后继续左行，下到第一处帐篷。从帐篷往下，敲铃展开临时平台。到坩埚房清掉出现的敌人，向右敲铃下落。
在右侧继续下落，敲铃移出平台，借平台攀到上方打第一根拉杆。继续向右打第二根，再完成右侧计时挑战。通关后直走领工坊代币，再折返计时装置旁往下。
找到第二处帐篷后，从旁边第一块平台下落，向右进埋葬墓穴打拉杆。折回玩偶师之家，从左侧继续下行，坐升降机到机关另一侧，用弹弓够到上方拉杆，打完继续往前进入首领战。
击败玩偶师之镜后向西救出玛格达，再去附近的能力巢穴完成教学，学会墙壁弹射。
en: With Endless Climb, go left from the Bog tent and cross the water on bubbles. Drop at the far left, pick up the doll resembling Magda and keep going into the house.
Speak to the Dollmaker, then go left and descend to the first tent. Drop below it and ring bells to extend temporary platforms. Clear the cauldron ambush, then go right and ring the bell to drop.

Drop on the right and ring the bell to move the platform into place. Climb it and strike the first lever above, then head right to the second lever and complete the time trial. Claim the Workshop Token ahead, then backtrack and drop beside the trial device.

At the second tent, drop from the first nearby platform and go right into Burial Vault to hit the lever. Backtrack into Dollmaker’s House, descend on the left and take the lift up on the opposite side. Use Slingshot to reach the upper lever, strike it and continue to the boss.
Defeat Dollmaker’s Mirror, go west to rescue Magda, and finish the nearby ability nest tutorial to learn Wall Sling.

zh: 参考路线使用墙壁弹射，从午夜雨境进入墓室。
向西推进至掘墓者；战后向左护送蜗牛到聚会处，继续领取金色羽毛。
en: The reference route enters from Midnight Drench using Wall Sling.
Continue west to Gravedigger, then escort the snail left to the party and Golden Feather.

zh: 掘墓者与聚会方向位于本区西侧。
en: The boss and party route are on the western side.

zh: 蜘蛛网：从击败排水道女士后的通道进入午夜暴雨，向下一间、向右两间，到气泡机关房。先用弹弓把火柴向右射过气泡，只踩最后出现、位于饰物下方的气泡，借它弹上去。装备后可用弹弓发射焰瓶。
斜屋顶书页：从午夜暴雨上方帐篷稍向右再向上，继续向右两间到斜屋顶。越过屋顶后检查最右端的暗墙，进暗道沿墙向上拾取。
东侧书页：从干涸城堡中央帐篷向右找升柱，在柱子降下时借弹弓跳到柱顶，再从右侧竖井上去。下一间从右边进入午夜暴雨东侧，遇到第一处向上的通道就上去，借气泡和悬停过缺口。两张书页都属于《女巫的交易》，可用全书页图文第 9、10 项核对房间。
en: Spider’s Web: Enter Midnight Drench from the passage beyond the Lady of the Drains, then go down one room and right two rooms to the bubble puzzle. Fire the matchstick right through the bubbles, then bounce only on the final bubble beneath the trinket. Equipping it lets you launch Flaming Vessels with Slingshot.

Slanted rooftop page: Go slightly right and up from the upper Midnight Drench tent, then right two rooms to the slanted rooftops. Cross them and check the hidden wall at the far right. Wall-jump up inside the passage to collect the page.

Eastern page: Go right from the central Desiccated Castle tent to the moving pillar. Use Slingshot to reach its top while it is lowered, then take the right-hand shaft up. Leave the next room to the right for eastern Midnight Drench. Take the first passage up and cross using bubbles and Hover. Both pages belong to The Witch’s Bargain; compare room maps in illustrated entries 9 and 10.

zh: 七子神龛路线：学会悬停后，从墓谷往南或从干涸城堡东北侧回到午夜暴雨。找到中央有浮动气泡的房间，借气泡过到对岸，从右侧出去。
下一间借浮动气泡升到顶部，从右上出口到帐篷存档。继续往东，沿气泡逐级向上，敲顶部开关。从那里往左上走进入七子神龛战场。
击败七子神龛后向左拾取金色羽毛，再操作附近的开关，打开通往干涸城堡的捷径。
从蛛雨旅店逃出后也会回到午夜暴雨。
墓谷救援后的路线：和艾格伯特交谈后，从他身后的地板下落，进入午夜暴雨另一侧。先去正下方房间，再从左下出口往下落。
沿路向左进入干涸城堡，接着落到下一层。继续往左找到东门开关，操作后到入口帐篷存档。
en: Shrine route: After learning Hover, return to Midnight Drench from southern Graven Valley or northeastern Desiccated Castle. Find the room with a floating bubble in the middle, bounce across and take the right exit.

Ride the bubbles to the top of the next room and take the upper-right exit to the save tent. Continue east and climb the bubbles to strike the switch at the top. From there, go up and left to the Shrine of the Seven Sons arena.
After defeating the Shrine, go left to pick up the Golden Feather and use the nearby switch to open a shortcut to Desiccated Castle.
Escaping the Innkeeper returns you to Midnight Drench.
After the Graven Valley rescue, drop through the floor beyond Egbert to reach the far side of Midnight Drench. Enter the room directly below, then descend again through its lower-left exit.
Head left into Desiccated Castle and drop to the lower room. Continue left to the east gate switch, activate it, then save at the entrance tent.

zh: 地图上的深蓝色区域；可用七子神龛场地定位金色羽毛路线。
en: The dark-blue region; use the Shrine arena to orient the feather route.

zh: 追逐主要向左推进。依次处理可破坏障碍、落地砸开的地板和需要敲钟切换的平台。
留意蛛网球的借力点；按画面中的交互提示操作。
最后长距离滑出后回到午夜雨境，并取得金色羽毛。
en: The chase runs mainly left. Handle breakable barriers, smashable floors and bell-switched platforms.
Watch for web-ball launch points and follow the on-screen interaction prompt.
The final long slide exits into Midnight Drench and awards a Golden Feather.

zh: 紫色区域；底部通道与向左追逐出口是主要地标。
en: A purple region; the lower passage and leftward chase exit are key landmarks.

zh: 集齐七根金色羽毛后，从沼泽进入城堡。
寻找 Ilda 的三对兄弟姐妹；其中一对由银色玩偶守护。
完成女王战后仍可回访补收集。
en: With seven Golden Feathers, enter the castle from the Bog.
Find Ilda's three sibling pairs; Silver Doll guards one pair.
Exploration and collection remain available after the Queen fight.

zh: 皇家紫色区域；先按兄弟姐妹任务推进到女王。
en: The royal-purple region; follow the sibling objective towards the Queen.

zh: 黑羽圈出现时用滑行穿过空隙；处理弹幕时仍要留意砸地起手。
后半段攻击更密集，保持移动，并在安全间隙使用火焰容器。
en: Slide through gaps in feather rings and watch for ground slams while reading projectiles.
Later patterns intensify; keep moving and use Flaming Vessels in safe openings.

zh: lookout-tower
en: lookout-tower

zh: 场地狭窄，主要危险来自环境；向上叶片出现时利用侧墙与悬停。
落石产生尖刺时，可借石块避开地面。战后继续向右检查羽毛。
en: In the narrow arena, use side walls and Hover against rising leaves.
Use fallen rocks to avoid floor spikes, then check right for the feather after the fight.

zh: autumn-forest
en: autumn-forest

zh: 中央光束与地面电流可结合侧墙攀爬、悬停处理。
弹跳电球会追踪位置；粉色光柱预告地面骨臂，尽早离开预告位置。
en: Combine side-wall climbing and Hover against central beams and floor electricity.
Keep moving from tracking electric balls; leave pink warning columns before bone arms emerge.

zh: midnight-drench
en: midnight-drench

zh: 在埋葬墓穴第二处帐篷休整，从帐篷向左进入掘墓人战场。
掘墓人砸铲后可能扬起碎骨，也可能沿地面冒出一排持续较久的骨刺。看到骨刺时跳起悬停，等尖刺消退再落地。
骨球会向五个方向散开，然后沿场地飞回。第一次躲开后留出第二次跳跃或滑行的空间。等掘墓人收招时靠近打几下火柴，再拉开距离。
胜利后继续向左到聚会屋，把 Irma 送到 Squinton 的生日聚会，完成剧情后领取金色羽毛。
en: Rest at the second Burial Vault tent and go left to enter the Gravedigger arena.
The shovel slam can scatter bones or send a line of lingering spikes across the floor. Jump and hover over the spikes until they subside.
Bone balls spread in five directions and then return. Leave room for a second jump or slide. When the Gravedigger finishes an attack, move in for a short matchstick combo and back away.
After victory, continue left to the party house. Escort Irma to Squinton’s birthday party and finish the scene to collect the Golden Feather.

zh: burial-vault
en: burial-vault

zh: 多镜下落时找眼睛朝上的镜子，移动到其下方安全区。
镜子贴地往返时会向外射出玻璃碎片。可以攀到墙上一小段，用无限攀爬稳住位置，同时留意飞来的碎片。碎片绕着镜子转时，等空隙再跳过。
约打到一半会进入分身阶段。右边的本体按正常方向移动，左边的倒影反向移动。镜子每次只在一侧出现，优先看它在哪边；两侧都落下能量球时，先看落球更密的一侧。
击败镜子后往西找 Magda，完成救援并核对成就。进入能力巢穴完成教学，取得墙壁弹射。
en: During falling mirrors, shelter beneath the mirror with the upward-looking eye.

When the mirror skims back and forth, it fires glass shards. Climb partway up a wall and use Endless Climb to hold your position while watching for shards. When shards orbit the mirror, wait for a gap before jumping past them.

Around halfway through, the right-hand Glimmer moves normally while the reflection on the left moves in the opposite direction. The mirror appears on one side at a time. When energy balls fall on both sides, prioritise the denser pattern.
After the fight, head west to rescue Magda and check for the achievement. Complete the ability nest tutorial to learn Wall Sling.

zh: dollmakers-house
en: dollmakers-house

zh: 共 23 页，分为《女巫的交易》9 页、《玩偶师》8 页、《瞭望塔》6 页。
菜单 Pages 分页可核对分组；女王战后可以继续补齐。
《女巫的交易》（9 页）：按书内顺序查夜之庭园（图文 1）、干涸城堡（5）、墓谷（6）、干涸城堡（8）、午夜暴雨（9、10）、猎人小屋（20）、干涸城堡（21）、女王城堡（23）。第 4 页要等干涸城堡的躲避女王段落结束后回收。
《玩偶师》（8 页）：依次查猎人小屋（图文 2）、沼泽（3）、秋日森林（13）、沼泽（15）、玩偶师之家（16、17）、埋葬墓穴（18）、玩偶师之家（19）。秋日森林那页在森林之王战后，进金羽毛房间查伊尔达右侧暗道。
《瞭望塔》（6 页）：依次查夜之庭园（图文 4）、墓谷（7）、瞭望塔（11、12）、深海（14）、沼泽（22）。深海那页可在解锁潜水载具、进入深海后拾取。
括号内是参考图文的全局编号，按编号可以找到对应房间截图。
en: 23 pages form three books: The Witch's Bargain (9), The Dollmaker (8) and The Lookout Tower (6).
Check the Pages menu by book; collection remains possible after the Queen fight.

The Witch’s Bargain (9 pages), in book order: Night Garden (walkthrough 1), Desiccated Castle (5), Graven Valley (6), Desiccated Castle (8), Midnight Drench (9–10), Hunter’s Cabin (20), Desiccated Castle (21), Queen’s Castle (23). Page 4 is available after the Queen evasion sequence.

The Dollmaker (8 pages): Hunter’s Cabin (walkthrough 2), the Bog (3), Autumn Forest (13), the Bog (15), Dollmaker’s House (16–17), Burial Vault (18), Dollmaker’s House (19). After the Forest King, check the hidden passage to Ilda’s right in the Golden Feather room.

The Lookout Tower (6 pages): Night Garden (walkthrough 4), Graven Valley (7), Lookout Tower (11–12), the Deep (14), the Bog (22). The Deep page is available once you unlock the submarine and enter the region.
Numbers in parentheses match the illustrated walkthrough’s global order. Use them to find the room screenshots.

zh: 攻击鸟形雕像释放灵魂，带回夜之庭园的灵魂标记处。
地图标记分别显示发现与归还数量；完成 20 次归还对应 Full Flock。
en: Strike bird statues to release spirits and return them at the Night Garden spirit marker.
The marker distinguishes found and returned counts; 20 returns complete Full Flock.

zh: 接任务：救出针儿和刺儿后，回码头船坞找 Barge 学无限攀爬。到码头第一个帐篷的上一层，找第二处帐篷旁可进入的旧靴子。进靴子和低语者谈话拿金门钥匙，之后按地图上的金锁标记找四扇门。
腿：用钥匙打开墓谷的金门，沿门后通路走到尽头拾取。
手臂：打开干涸城堡的金门，穿过门后区域，到尽头找零件。
躯干：打开下水道的金门后往东走，沿支路找到躯干。
头：打开沼泽的金门，沿门后区域向上攀，到最高处拾取。
交付：四件齐全后跟地图的新目标回码头旧靴子，与低语者交谈并拼好拾荒者，领取一根金色羽毛，同时解锁对应成就。
en: Start: After rescuing Thimble and Thistle, learn Endless Climb from Barge at the Docks shipyard. Go one level above the first Docks tent and enter the old boot beside the second tent. Speak to Whisper for the Golden Gate Key, then follow the four gold padlock markers on the map.
Legs: Open the Golden Gate in Graven Valley and follow the passage to its end.
Arms: Open the Golden Gate in Desiccated Castle and look for the part at the end of the area beyond it.
Body: Open the Golden Gate in the Drains, then follow the eastern branch to the part.
Head: Open the Golden Gate in the Bog and climb to the top of the area beyond it.
Hand-in: Once you have all four parts, follow the new map objective back to the old boot at the Docks. Speak to Whisper and reassemble Looter to receive a Golden Feather and unlock the achievement.

zh: 先学御风：从中央帐篷向右穿过有风和尖刺的房间，在右侧出口前沿平台下落。到下层底部后向右，清掉战斗房的四个敌人。继续向右，下一间再下落后右转，找到能力蛋并完成教学。
右上零件：从有金门的房间向上找气流，用御风进入上层房间，再爬到顶端拾取。
左下零件：连续向左穿过风区与尖刺，借气泡越过长缺口。进入左边下一间后，把火柴插进墙里，借它弹跳上去拿零件。
中央帐篷上方：跳过管道，上到点着蜡烛的风道，御风升到上一间，零件在右侧。再往上一层可开通往夜之庭园的捷径。
集齐三件后回中央帐篷旁的升降机，操作拉杆下行，进入排水道女士的战斗。还差一件时，按右上金门、左下气泡、帐篷上方蜡烛三处地标逐一回查。
en: Learn Wind Ride first: Head right from the central tent through the windy spike room. Drop down from the platforms before the right exit, then turn right at the bottom and clear the four enemies. Continue right, drop in the next room and go right again for the Ability Egg and tutorial.
Upper-right part: Head up from the Golden Gate room and ride the current into the room above. Continue to the top for the part.
Lower-left part: Head left past wind and spikes, using the bubble to cross. In the next room, plant the matchstick in the wall and bounce up to the part.
Above the central tent: Jump over the pipe to the candle-lit wind shaft. Ride the current into the next room and collect the part on the right. Continue upward to open a shortcut into Night Garden.

Bring all three parts to the lift beside the central tent and pull the lever to descend to the Lady of the Drains fight. If a part is missing, check the three landmarks: the upper-right Golden Gate, the lower-left bubble and the candles above the tent.

zh: 女王寝室西门需要集齐 32 件饰物，其中一件是把 20 个灵魂送回夜之庭园鸟巢的奖励。开门后拾取巢中的能力蛋，完成指引学会腾空，再飞到巢上方取得神秘标记。
玩偶师之家：到最高一层通道的中央房间，腾空进入上方隐藏区，走到尽头拾取。
夜之庭园：从通往沼泽的最西侧房间腾空，清理隐藏区的战斗房，再沿上方通道取碎片。
秋日森林：在计时挑战房西侧的房间腾空，完成隐藏区的平台跳跃，在终点拾取。
码头：从 Whisper 小屋旁的帐篷往东到桥上，腾空进入隐藏区。登上顶部平台再跳下，下落途中收齐 100 个闪光物。
码头挑战技巧：闪光物会从屏幕下方往上移动。尽量待在画面偏下的位置，左右跟着下一组移动；漏过一个时还有空间向上补捡。若确定漏捡，可按画面左下角提示重置，也可以先走到终点看完排列再重试。
干涸城堡：到东南角的帐篷，站在帐篷右侧鸟巢处腾空，爬到隐藏塔顶取碎片。五枚齐全后，回夜之庭园的灵魂鸟巢触发真结局。
en: The western door in the Queen’s chambers requires all 32 trinkets. One is the reward for returning 20 spirits to the Night Garden nest. Beyond the door, complete the Ability Egg tutorial to learn Soar, then fly above the nest to find Mysterious Markings.
Dollmaker’s House: Soar from the middle room on the top corridor and follow the hidden passage to the end.
Night Garden: Soar from the far-west room connecting to the Bog. Clear the combat room and follow the upper path.
Autumn Forest: Soar in the room west of the time trial. Clear the platforming route to the pickup.
The Docks: Use Soar from the bridge east of the tent by Whisper’s hut. Climb the hidden area and leap from the top platform to collect 100 lights on the way down.

Docks challenge tips: The lights rise from the bottom of the screen. Stay low and move sideways toward the next group, leaving room to move up for a missed light. Follow the lower-left reset prompt if you miss one, or finish the attempt to see the remaining patterns before retrying.

Desiccated Castle: Soar from the nest to the right of the southeastern tent and climb the hidden tower. Once all five fragments are collected, return to the Night Garden spirit nest for the true ending.

zh: 金色羽毛共七根，用于开放女王城堡入口。
下水道：修好升降机并下到底层，击败下水道夫人后，到后续房间拾取羽毛。
午夜暴雨：击败七子神龛后往西走，拾取羽毛。
拾荒者零件：收齐四块零件，回去交给低语者领取羽毛。
瞭望塔：登上最高处，击败星歌者领取羽毛。
秋日森林：击败东北侧的森林之王，继续向东到下一间拾取。
埋葬墓穴：击败掘墓人后，到 Squinton 的住处完成聚会，再领取羽毛。
蛛网旅店：完成区域末尾的追逐，在终点拾取羽毛。
瞭望塔的三次飞行时长升级不是金色羽毛。
en: Seven Golden Feathers open the Queen's Castle entrance.
The Drains: Repair the elevator and descend. Defeat the Lady of the Drains, then collect the feather in the room beyond.
Midnight Drench: Defeat Shrine of the Seven Sons, then head west for the feather.
Looter Parts: Collect all four parts and return to Whisper for the feather.
Lookout Tower: Reach the top and defeat Starsinger for the feather.
Autumn Forest: Defeat the Forest King in the northeast, then go east to collect the feather.
Burial Vault: Defeat Gravedigger, then finish the party at Squinton’s place to receive the feather.
Webdrench Inn: Finish the chase at the end of the area and pick up the feather at the finish.
The tower's three flight-duration upgrades are separate items.

zh: 取得风乘，寻找排水道三处部件，再回中央帐篷旁电梯。
en: Acquire Wind Ride, find the three Drains parts and return to the central-tent elevator.

en: elevator-parts

zh: 从午夜暴雨右端下落后往左，用弹弓和攀爬越过平台，再向下进入埋葬墓穴。到木牌后往左，下落一层就沿左侧走，和蜗牛 Irma 交谈接下护送。
从第一处帐篷向上，在到顶之前转左。走到底下落，再往右清掉坩埚房的敌人。折回房外的坑向下，走左侧通道，再沿箭矢陷阱向右，操作右侧拉杆打开下方通路。
回到左侧，借箭矢平台向上，听 Irma 指路。继续攀爬通过箭矢和尖刺区，沿上层向左到第二处帐篷。帐篷左侧就是掘墓者战场。
击败掘墓者后继续向左，护送 Irma 到 Club Casket，参加 Squinton 的生日聚会。完成聚会剧情后领取金色羽毛。
en: Drop at the far right of Midnight Drench and head left. Use Slingshot and Climb to cross the platform and descend into Burial Vault. Go left past the wooden sign, drop once, then stay left and speak to Irma the snail to start the escort.

Climb above the first tent and turn left before reaching the top. Drop at the end and head right to clear the cauldron ambush. Backtrack to the pit, descend and take the left passage, then follow the arrow traps right and strike the lever to open the route below.

Return left and climb the arrow platforms until Irma gives directions. Continue through the arrows and spikes and stay on the upper route heading left to the second tent. The Gravedigger arena is just west of it.
After defeating the Gravedigger, continue left and escort Irma to Club Casket for Squinton’s birthday. Finish the party scene to claim the Golden Feather.

zh: burial-vault
en: burial-vault

zh: 收齐七根金色羽毛后，回沼泽的城堡入口。
en: Return to the Bog castle entrance with all seven Golden Feathers.

zh: queens-castle
en: queens-castle

zh: 取得处刑门票后进入遭遇。追踪刀刃出现时留意滑行冷却。
后半段场地收窄，观察三把下落刀刃之间的空隙；战后左侧寻找 Egbert。
en: Enter after obtaining the execution ticket; track homing blades and your slide cooldown.
As the arena narrows, use gaps between falling cleavers. Find Egbert to the left afterwards.

zh: graven-valley
en: graven-valley

zh: 先在码头集齐三块门石，按地图标记通过开启的大门。击败深海怪物后即可使用潜水载具进入深海。
首领会持鱼剑横穿场地，也会放出空中弹射物和沿地传播的冲击波。横冲时用跳跃或滑行换位；冲击波贴地过来时跳起悬停，等它从脚下过去再落地。
空中弹射物出现时先看落点，留出落地空间。等首领结束冲刺或挥剑，再贴近还击或投出火焰容器。胜利后解锁 Into the Deep 成就。
en: Collect all three Gate Stones in the Docks and follow the map marker through the opened gate. Defeating the Creature unlocks access to the submarine and the Deep.

The boss charges across the arena with its swordfish blade and sends out airborne projectiles and ground shockwaves. Jump or slide to reposition during a charge. For a ground wave, jump and Hover until it passes beneath you.
Watch where airborne projectiles are headed before choosing a landing spot. Wait for a charge or swing to end before closing in or throwing a Flaming Vessel. Victory unlocks Into the Deep.

zh: the-docks
en: the-docks

zh: 击败码头的深海怪物后，乘潜水载具前往深渊。用巨型骷髅辨认入口。
前半段由多个敌人轮番攻击。移动时同时看空中的弹射物和贴地冲击波。跳过冲击波前先找安全落点，等弹道露出空隙再攻击。
约打到一半时，最终形态会落入场内，一边跳动一边发射追踪尖刺。先持续换位摆脱追踪，再趁它落地时反击。
若使用火焰容器，可在存档帐篷以标价 250 购入瓶盖。装备后瓶子触地会弹跳，适合首领频繁换位时使用。
战后救出 Thistle 和 Thimble，解锁 Double Trouble。看完兄弟姐妹团聚剧情，回码头船坞找 Barge，领取无限攀爬。拿到后可持续攀墙，无需担心攀爬体力耗尽。
en: After defeating the Creature at the Docks, take the submarine to the Depths. Look for the giant skull that marks the entrance.

Several enemies attack during the first half. Track airborne projectiles and ground shockwaves at the same time. Pick a clear landing spot before jumping over a wave, then attack when the projectiles leave an opening.
Around halfway through, the final form drops into the arena. It jumps around and fires homing spikes. Keep moving until the spikes pass, then punish a landing.
If you use Flaming Vessels, Bottle Cap costs 250 at the Save Tent before discounts. It lets bottles bounce, which helps when the boss keeps moving.
Victory rescues Thistle and Thimble and unlocks Double Trouble. Finish the reunion sequence, then speak to Barge at the Docks shipyard for Endless Climb, which removes the climbing stamina limit.

zh: the-deep
en: the-deep

zh: 进场：在女王城堡找到封住的竖坑，敲左侧转轮打开落口。下到底部后右转进入战场。
跳砸和火球：银色玩偶起跳后会在落地时掀起尖刺或碎片。先离开落点，再跳起避开贴地危险。远处还有火球，等弹道露出空隙后再靠近。
带刺滚轮：滚轮先散向两边，再朝中央滚回。可用悬停拖过前一只，落地后接滑行躲下一只。若已靠近侧墙，可攀墙等滚轮过去。
反击和战后：等跳砸或滚轮攻势结束，再贴近打几下。胜利后向右走，敲牢笼旁的拉杆，救出一对伊尔达的兄弟姐妹。
en: Approach: Strike the wheel left of the blocked shaft in the Queen’s Castle. Drop to the bottom and turn right to enter the arena.
Leaps and fireballs: The Silver Doll’s landing sends up spikes or shards. Move away from the landing point, then jump over the ground hazards. Wait for an opening between fireballs before closing in.
Spiked wheels: The wheels spread to the sides, then roll back toward the middle. Hover over one and slide after landing to avoid the next, or cling to a side wall until they pass.
Punish and rescue: Move in for a short attack once the jump or wheel sequence ends. After victory, go right and strike the cage lever to free one pair of Ilda’s siblings.

zh: queens-castle
en: queens-castle

zh: 进入王城前先集齐七根金羽毛。进城后击败银色玩偶，并找到伊尔达的兄弟姐妹，再前往女王战。
前半段看到地刺冒出时，用悬停跨过去。金剑或带刺的大方块逼近时，用跳跃接滑行换位。遇到环绕的大火球，用滑行穿过，并为下一次闪避留出冷却时间。
战斗中段刺墙收拢、地面长出尖刺时，立刻转移到升起的平台。留意头顶落剑和圆锯，平台被封住时先悬停调整。看到带碎箭标记的平台，把火柴投向标记，再借火柴弹跳过去。
en: Collect the seven golden feathers to enter the Queen’s Castle. Defeat Silver Doll and find Ilda’s siblings before proceeding to the Queen.

In the first half, hover over rising floor spikes. Use a jump and slide to reposition around golden swords or large spiked blocks. Slide through the orbiting fireballs and allow time for the slide to recharge.

When the spike walls close in and the floor sprouts spikes, move onto the raised platforms. Watch for falling swords and saws, and use Hover when a landing is blocked. Aim the matchstick at the splintered-arrow marker, then bounce off it to cross.

zh: queens-castle
en: queens-castle

zh: 虫群在上方时向上攻击；侧面虫墙出现时借泡泡越过。
出现头骨后可攻击头骨，但需额外躲避砸地产生的冲击波。
en: Attack upward when the swarm is overhead; use bubbles to clear insect walls.
Once the skull appears, attack it while avoiding its added ground-slam shockwave.

zh: the-bog
en: the-bog

zh: 三处电梯部件齐全后，从中央帐篷旁电梯进入。敌人在上方时向上攻击，先处理生成的小怪。
敌人消失、场地滚动时专注躲避下方尖球，留意滑行冷却。
en: Enter via the central-tent elevator with all three parts. Attack upward and clear summoned enemies first.
When the boss disappears and the arena scrolls, focus on lower spike balls and your slide cooldown.

zh: the-drains
en: the-drains

zh: 从墓谷帐篷下到底层，与处刑会场入口的报幕人对话。对话后，地图会标出门票的位置。
沿下层往右，用空中下砸破开地板。清掉下方战斗房的敌人后，沿平台继续往右，到售票人处对话拿门票。
传送回墓谷帐篷，再下到会场入口出示门票。等两名囚犯被带进场后，走到左侧用火柴打断绳子，触发莉达战。
战后去左侧房间与艾格伯特交谈，完成救援并解锁成就。从他身后的地板继续下落，可到午夜暴雨的另一侧。
en: Descend from the Graven Valley tent to the execution entrance and speak to the announcer. This adds the ticket location to your map.
Take the lower route to the right and use Ground Slam to break through the floor. Clear the combat room below, then keep right through the platforms and speak to the ticketer.
Fast travel back to the Graven Valley tent and show the ticket at the entrance below. Once both prisoners are brought in, go left and strike the rope with the matchstick to start the Lida fight.
After the fight, speak to Egbert in the room to the left to complete the rescue and unlock the achievement. Drop through the floor beyond him to reach the far side of Midnight Drench.

zh: graven-valley
en: graven-valley

zh: 深入深渊并击败 The Colony，救出 Thistle 和 Thimble，解锁 Double Trouble。团聚剧情结束后，回码头船坞找 Barge 领取无限攀爬。
en: Defeat the Colony in the Depths to rescue Thistle and Thimble and unlock Double Trouble. After the reunion, speak to Barge at the Docks shipyard for Endless Climb.

zh: the-deep
en: the-deep

zh: 带七根金色羽毛从沼泽进入女王城堡。上行见到伊尔达后，在附近的第一处城堡帐篷存档。救援共有三处牢笼，靠近所在房间时才会出现对应的目标标记。
银色玩偶右侧：敲封闭竖坑左边的转轮，落到底后向右打银色玩偶。战后继续右行，敲牢笼旁的拉杆。
第一处城堡帐篷左侧：从帐篷往左敲转轮，到尽头落下，先向右走到下层，再折向左，爬墙找到牢笼拉杆。
第二处城堡帐篷上方：从下层牢笼后爬墙到第二处帐篷。往左沿平台攀升，清掉大锅旁刷出的敌人，再爬到另一侧打开最后一处牢笼。
三对全救出后，传送回最初遇见伊尔达附近的帐篷，向左找她对话。借兄弟姐妹叠成的落脚点跳上平台，沿途与兄弟姐妹和拾荒者交谈。
经过拾荒者后，在下一处帐篷存档。继续走到吊笼，与母亲交谈，再沿通道前往女王战。若回到伊尔达处仍走不通，先核对三个牢笼旁的拉杆是否都已操作。
en: Bring seven Golden Feathers to the Bog entrance to Queen’s Castle. Climb to Ilda and save at the first castle tent nearby. There are three cages, and their objective markers appear as you approach the rooms.
Beyond Silver Doll: Strike the wheel left of the blocked shaft. Drop to the bottom and head right to fight Silver Doll, then keep going right and strike the cage lever.
Left of the first castle tent: Head left and strike the wheel. Drop at the end, head right into the lower area, then take the left passage and climb to the cage lever.
Above the second castle tent: Climb behind the lower cage to the second tent. Follow the platforms up and left, clear the enemies by the cauldron and climb to the last cage.

Once all three pairs are free, fast travel to the tent near your first meeting with Ilda and go left to speak with her. Jump onto the platform using the stacked siblings as footholds, then speak to the siblings and Looter along the way.

Save at the next tent past Looter, speak to Mother at the hanging cage and follow the passage to the Queen. If the route by Ilda is still blocked, check that you operated the lever by each of the three cages.

zh: queens-castle
en: queens-castle

zh: 女王城堡内共有三对；解救后按目标提示回到 Ilda，衔接女王路线。
en: Three pairs in Queen's Castle; after rescue, follow the objective back to Ilda for the Queen route.

zh: 学会腾空后，回女王寝室西门内的能力蛋鸟巢。先砸地，再立刻按住跳跃，从鸟巢向上穿过竖井，到上层房间拾取神秘标记。
打开地图确认五处碎片标记，分别在玩偶师之家、夜之庭园、秋日森林、码头和干涸城堡。到标记附近找可腾空进入的上方通道。收齐后回夜之庭园的灵魂鸟巢。
en: After learning Soar, return to the Ability Egg nest beyond the western door in the Queen’s chambers. Slam the ground and immediately hold Jump to rise through the shaft. Pick up Mysterious Markings in the room above.

Open the map to find the five fragment markers in Dollmaker’s House, Night Garden, Autumn Forest, the Docks and Desiccated Castle. Near each marker, look for a passage above that you can reach with Soar. Return to the Night Garden spirit nest with all five.

zh: 资料清单记录 27 枚。工坊代币配合货币，用于帐篷工坊升级可升级饰物。
图标为带锤子的铜色五边形；先核对饰物是否已达到最高等级。
解锁工坊（来源地图第 4 项）：到下水道底部救出 Willow 的朋友，回自己的帐篷查看工坊，并拾取帐篷内的代币。
柱子机关（来源地图第 6 项）：用弹弓把火柴射进柱子左侧，升起柱子后，借火柴够到上方代币。
气泡台阶（来源地图第 7 项）：站在中央，用弹弓打破气泡，每打破一个就登上一阶，直到顶端。
平台下方（来源地图第 9 项）：沿平台逐层往下落，检查底部的小暗室，代币就在里面。以上编号可在参考清单点开对应房间地图。
1：攀住笼子侧面，让笼子落下，露出通路。
2：敲下方的铃，趁平台消失前跳到墙上伸出的木柱，再攀上去。
3：敲天花板上的拉杆开门。5：进入隐藏房间取代币。
8：进入气泡，从中斜向射出，再跳上代币所在平台。10：需要悬停才能抵达。
11：沿西墙攀升，用墙壁弹射把火柴插进墙里，再借它弹上平台。12：完成平台挑战。13：检查浴场顶部。
14：用弹弓升到上方墙边，再攀上去。15：带上墙壁弹射，便于到达高处。16：进入气泡竖井，用下劈快速落到底。
17：完成计时挑战打开房间。18：沿西墙爬到顶端，进入隐藏竖井走到底。19：进暗道拾取。
20：门西侧有小凹室。下落触发平台伸出，避开平台，等它缩回时跟进去。21：打破墙壁。22：完成平台挑战。
23：敲第一口铃，跳过缺口，借蛛网弹射到第二口铃并在空中敲响。悬停回蛛网处，再借力弹上去。
24：查房间中央的小凹室。25：用墙壁弹射爬上平台。26：穿过尖刺路段。27：完成平台挑战领奖。
en: The reference checklist records 27 tokens. Spend tokens and currency at the tent workshop on upgradeable trinkets.
Look for bronze pentagons with a hammer; check each trinket's upgrade level.
Workshop unlock (map entry 4): Rescue Willow’s friends at the bottom of the Drains. Return to your tent for the workshop and pick up the token inside.
Pillar mechanism (map entry 6): Fire the matchstick into the left side of the pillar. Raise the pillar, then use the matchstick to reach the token above.
Bubble steps (map entry 7): Stand in the middle and pop the bubbles with Slingshot. Move up one step after each shot until you reach the top.
Below the platforms (map entry 9): Drop from platform to platform and check the small hidden space at the bottom. Use the numbered entries in the linked checklist to open the room maps.
1: Climb the side of the cage to drop it and open the path.
2: Ring the lower bell. Before the platforms vanish, jump onto the wooden post and climb up.
3: Strike the ceiling lever to open the door. 5: Check the hidden room.
8: Enter the bubble, launch diagonally and jump onto the ledge. 10: Bring Hover.
11: Climb the west wall, plant the matchstick with Wall Sling and launch onto the upper ledge. 12: Clear the platforming challenge. 13: Check the top of the spa.
14: Use Slingshot to reach the wall above, then climb. 15: Bring Wall Sling for the climb. 16: Enter the bubble shaft and use a downward attack to drop to the bottom.
17: Clear the time trial to open the room. 18: Climb the west wall, then follow the hidden shaft. 19: Check the hidden passage.
20: Drop to extend the platform by the western nook. Dodge it, then follow it as it retracts. 21: Break the wall. 22: Clear the platforming challenge.
23: Ring the first bell and jump the gap. Use the web sling to reach the second bell and strike it midair. Hover back to the sling, then launch upward.
24: Check the alcove in the middle of the room. 25: Use Wall Sling to reach the platform. 26: Cross the spike gauntlet. 27: Clear the platforming challenge.

zh: 按用途查找钥匙、部件、金色羽毛和剧情标记；下方目录可进入各物品页。
en: Browse keys, parts, Golden Feathers and story markers by purpose; open each item from the directory below.

zh: 按任务用途检查物品：电梯维修、Looter 修复，以及城堡救援。
en: Check items by objective: elevator repair, Looter restoration and castle rescues.

zh: elevator-parts
looter-parts
ildas-siblings
en: elevator-parts
looter-parts
ildas-siblings

zh: 秋日森林的木车商贩出售节庆帽，资料价格为 10 货币；购买对应 The King's Cap 成就。
商贩位于球与立柱谜题之后的一间房。
en: A cart merchant in Autumn Forest sells a festive hat for 10 currency in the reference guide; buying it completes The King's Cap.
Look in the room following an orb-and-pillar puzzle.

zh: autumn-forest
en: autumn-forest

zh: 用弹弓把火柴打到障碍前方，借火柴弹跳越过去。遇到低处的尖刺障碍时接滑行，过了就继续跑。完成后获得饰物槽。
en: Use Slingshot to place the matchstick ahead of obstacles and bounce over them. Slide past low spike hazards and keep running. Reward: a trinket slot.

zh: 带上攀爬，从竖向赛道一路贴墙上爬。需要换边时用蹬墙跳接到另一面墙，继续往顶端走。奖励是饰物槽。
en: Bring Climb and follow the vertical course upward. Wall-jump across when you need to switch sides and climb to the finish. Reward: a trinket slot.

zh: 带上攀爬和悬停。这场向上计时，沿墙爬升，需要换边就蹬墙跳，遇到气泡就借它向上弹。完成后救出一个灵魂。
en: Bring Climb and Hover for this vertical trial. Wall-jump to switch sides and bounce on bubbles to gain height. Reward: a spirit.

zh: 带上攀爬、悬停和弹弓。赛道交替出现横向跑跳与上升段，平路保持奔跑，上升段留意需要借力的位置。完成后救出一个灵魂。
en: Bring Climb, Hover and Slingshot. The course alternates between horizontal runs and climbs. Keep your speed on flat stretches and look for the next way up at each climb. Reward: a spirit.

zh: 带上悬停和攀爬。在下落平台上看准旋转刺球的空隙，必要时稍停，趁平台还没掉远就悬停跨过去。完成后救出一个灵魂。
en: Bring Hover and Climb. On the falling platforms, briefly wait for a gap in the rotating spike balls if needed, then hover across before the platform drops too far. Reward: a spirit.

zh: 挑战内无需额外能力。从高处一路往下，记住下一层缺口的位置，落地后用滑行快速接上下一段。完成后获得饰物槽。
en: No extra ability is needed in the trial. Descend quickly, remember where each drop is and slide after landing to reach the next one. Reward: a trinket slot.

zh: 挑战内无需额外能力。跑过平地时保持速度，遇到缺口就跳，低矮障碍用滑行通过。时间余量较少，完成后救出一个灵魂。
en: No extra ability is needed in the trial. Keep running on flat ground, jump gaps and slide through low obstacles. Time is tight. Reward: a spirit.

zh: 挑战内无需额外能力。起步后踩气泡连续向上弹，够到上方通道后立刻横向通过。完成后获得工坊代币。
en: No extra ability is needed in the trial. Chain bubble bounces to gain height, then cross as soon as you reach the upper path. Reward: a Workshop Token.

zh: 起跑时先用弹弓射出火柴，再跑过前方平台。抵达插着火柴的位置后，借火柴弹跳上高处。
末段遇到移动刺球，可稍等间隙再通过。完成挑战后，奖励路线需要无限攀爬，可领取饰物槽。参考全收集图文第 74 项。
en: Fire the matchstick as the timer starts, then sprint across the platforms. Bounce off the planted matchstick to reach the upper path.
Near the finish, wait briefly for a gap between moving spike balls. The reward route requires Endless Climb and leads to a trinket slot. See entry 74 in the collectible walkthrough.

zh: 带上无限攀爬和悬停。这是一条向上的路线，贴墙往上爬，需要换边时从一侧墙跳到另一侧，接着向上。
完成挑战后获得鱼钩饰物，低血量时可加快火焰容器补充。
en: Bring Endless Climb and Hover. Climb the vertical route, wall-jumping across to the opposite wall when you need to switch sides.
Finish the trial to earn Fish Hook, which speeds Flaming Vessel refill at low health.

zh: 银勺：站在机关房东侧出口旁的平台，用弹弓打西侧齿轮，收起挡住上层的活动平台。再把火柴射到下方草地平台，踩火柴向上弹，贴墙攀到银勺处。装备后，开始治疗时会短暂出现护盾。
烧焦鞋带：从东侧操作拉杆打开塔楼的门，再沿中央竖井蹬墙上攀拾取。装备后，全速奔跑会留下余烬。
《女巫的交易》第 4 页：打完躲避女王段落后再回收，带弹弓和攀爬，对照全书页图文第 8 项的房间图。
《女巫的交易》第 8 页：用弹弓触发地板机关，沿右侧升柱上升。升到与左侧横伸的尖刺柱齐平时，把火柴用作落脚点，再跳过去。对应全书页图文第 21 项。
en: Silver Spoon: From the platform by the east exit of the puzzle room, use Slingshot to hit the gear on the west side and retract the platform blocking the upper route. Fire the matchstick into the grassy platform below, bounce up and climb the wall to the Spoon. Equipping it briefly shields you when you start healing.
Burnt Shoelace: Open the tower doors with the lever to the east, then wall-jump up the central shaft to collect it. Equipping it leaves a trail of embers when you run at full speed.
The Witch’s Bargain page 4: Return after completing the Queen evasion sequence. Bring Slingshot and Climb and use the room map in illustrated story-page entry 8.

The Witch’s Bargain page 8: Trigger the floor switch with Slingshot and ascend on the right pillar. When level with the extendable spike pillar on the left, use the matchstick as a foothold to jump across. See illustrated story-page entry 21.

zh: 从干涸城堡帐篷向右，在缺口下落，沿路找到戴上金耳环的拾荒者。剧情结束后进入女王搜寻段落。
贴着墙等光束扫向另一侧，再跑到下一处遮挡。遇到封路时，攀上平台操作拉杆，再沿通道追上拾荒者。
看到拾荒者被带走后，继续往右，在尽头下落。走到下层尽头，爬上平台后向左，调查鸟巢里的能力蛋。
在教学区按住跳跃键练习悬停，跨过缺口到出口。离开鸟巢后向左回帐篷存档。
en: Go right from the Desiccated Castle tent, drop through the gap and follow the passage to Looter as he puts on the golden earring. The Queen’s search starts after the scene.
Wait behind a wall until the beam sweeps away, then move to the next cover. At the blocked passage, climb the platforms and strike the lever before continuing to Looter.
After Looter is taken away, continue right and drop at the end. Follow the lower passage to its end, climb the platforms, then go left to the Ability Egg in the nest.
Hold jump in the air to practise Hover in the tutorial and cross to the exit. Leave the nest and head left to save at the tent.

zh: 饰物槽第 49 项：拿到鱼雷后回上一段，从左上通道下潜。用鱼雷打通阻塞后，在粉色刺状生物附近向左，击破堵路的金属尖刺球，沿支路到底拾取。回到粉色刺状生物处往右，才是第一根拉杆的方向。
饰物槽第 50 项：这是另一处深海拾取。实机图文把它标为无需额外能力，可直接对照该项房间截图补拿，无需再找一处鱼雷障碍。
《瞭望塔》第 5 页：用码头帐篷左侧的载具走第二道闸门路线，沿水道下到底，再从另一侧上浮。书页在去第二根拉杆的途中，对应全书页图文第 14 项。
en: Trinket slot entry 49: Backtrack from Torpedo and take the upper-left passage down. Shoot through the blockage. At the pink spiked creatures, head left, destroy the metal spiked ball and follow the branch to the pickup. Return to the pink creatures and go right to resume the first-lever route.
Trinket slot entry 50: This is a separate pickup in the Deep. The illustrated guide lists no extra ability for this slot. Check the room screenshot for entry 50 if you missed it.

The Lookout Tower page 5: Board the vessel left of the Docks tent and follow the second-gate route. Dive to the bottom of the passage, then rise on the far side. Pick up the page on the way to the second lever. See illustrated story-page entry 14.

zh: 从码头帐篷向右，下到底层登上载具。入水后沿右侧下潜，再一路往右，到尽头折向左边下潜，顺路拿到鱼雷。
第一道门：拿鱼雷后回上一段，走左上通道，击碎水下障碍。遇到粉色刺状生物时往右，清开挡路的尖刺球，再折回下潜，从另一侧上浮，往右到底操作第一根拉杆。
第二道门：传送回码头帐篷，这次向左登上另一艘载具。用鱼雷打通左侧水路，顺着下沉的刺球往下，经过书页所在的通道后继续向左，穿过窄道用鱼雷击中第二根拉杆。
两道门打开后，下潜进入巨型骷髅，先在深海帐篷休整，再挑战 The Colony。救出针儿和刺儿并看完团聚剧情，回码头船坞找 Barge 学无限攀爬。
en: From the Docks tent, head right and drop to the lowest level to board the vessel. Dive down the right side, continue to the far right, then turn left and dive again to find Torpedo.

First gate: Backtrack from Torpedo, take the upper-left passage and shoot through the blockage. At the pink spiked creatures, go right and clear the spiked ball. Double back and dive, rise on the far side, then go right to the first lever.

Second gate: Fast travel to the Docks tent and board the vessel on the left. Shoot through the left-hand blockage, follow the sinking spike balls down and continue left past the story page. Shoot the second lever through the narrow passage.
With both gates open, dive into the giant skull. Rest at the Deep tent and face The Colony. Finish the twins’ rescue and reunion, then return to Barge at the Docks shipyard for Endless Climb.

zh: 缠线钉：从码头右侧帐篷向上两间，再往右过气泡机关，继续向上。带上攀爬和悬停。装备后，敌人被击败时会产生小爆炸。
邮票：从同一处帐篷向上五间，再向左到计时挑战石像。继续向左一间后下落，在尖刺房用弹弓把火柴变成落脚点，配合攀爬和悬停过去。装备后，无伤连续击败敌人可获得更多货币。
回访时可顺路补收集：从右侧帐篷向上三间，在房间左端的平台查灵魂石像。经过计时挑战石像时，也可完成挑战并进入奖励房领取饰物槽。
en: Nails with Twine: From the right-hand Docks tent, go up two rooms, head right through the bubble puzzle and continue upward. Bring Climb and Hover. With it equipped, defeated enemies produce a small explosion.

Postage Stamp: From the same tent, go up five rooms and left to the time trial statue. Go left one more room and drop down. Use Slingshot to place the matchstick as a foothold across the spikes, with Climb and Hover. Equipping it boosts currency from consecutive kills without taking damage.

For nearby pickups, go up three rooms from the right-hand tent and check the far-left platform for a spirit statue. At the time trial statue, complete the challenge and enter the reward room for a trinket slot.

zh: 第一块：从码头的帐篷向右走，转进上方支路拾取白色门石。
第二块：拿完第一块后退回下层，沿能走的路线一直向右，到尽头找第二块。
第三块：从第二块的位置往下，到区域底部附近再向右。走到右侧后转而向上，门石在这条路线的最上方。
三块齐全后，地图会标出大门。跟标记回门口，通过后击败深海生物并救出船员。
战后继续走到篝火，听完船员与 Barge 的对话。获得载具使用权后，再回码头水边登上载具前往深海。
en: First stone: Head right from the Docks tent, then take the upper branch to the white stone.
Second stone: Drop back down from the first pickup. Follow the route as far right as it goes to find the second.
Third stone: Descend from the second pickup toward the bottom of the area, then head right. Turn upward and follow the route to its highest point for the third stone.
Once you have all three, follow the new map marker back to the gate. Head through, defeat the Creature from the Deep and rescue the crew member.
Continue to the campfire and finish the crew member’s conversation with Barge. Once vessel access is granted, board a vessel at the Docks to reach the Deep.

zh: 饰物来自地图探索与 Looter 商店，共 32 件；装备前核对效果与占用槽数。
槽位消耗 1：蜘蛛网。
槽位消耗 3：小女巫雕像（Tiny Witch Sculpture）、鸟形纽扣。
槽位消耗 4：骷髅钥匙扣、猎人吊坠、臼齿、鱼钩、玻璃碎片、Pearl Jewelry、一束头发、瓶盖、玻璃眼、融化的蜡烛、余烬瓶、玩偶头、虫翅、发簪、蓝色蝴蝶结、破铃、烧焦鞋带。
槽位消耗 5：生锈叉、缠线钉、布片、Paper Clip with String、风化硬币、邮票、裂纹弹珠、生锈顶针、生锈罗盘、金针。
槽位消耗 6：银勺、银戒指。
猎人吊坠（Hunter’s Locket）：在猎人小屋拾取，无需额外能力。装备后，进行治疗时有更宽裕的操作窗口。
玻璃眼（Glass Eye）：在存档帐篷的拾荒者商店购买，标价 450。装备后可看见隐藏通道。
发簪（Hair Pin）：在沼泽按气泡出现的先后顺序踩弹，打开障碍后取得。连续 8 秒未攻击时，下一击伤害翻倍。
埋葬墓穴与夜之庭园：金针（Golden Needle）在埋葬墓穴，生命低于 25% 时会在身边生成一圈尖刺。一束头发（Bundle of Hair）在夜之庭园，砸地时会迸出余烬。两件都无需额外能力，可对照参考图文第 4、6 项的房间地图。
下水道：融化的蜡烛（Melted Candle）需要御风，治疗后获得 2 秒无敌。参照图文第 8 项。
墓谷：破铃（Broken Bell）无需额外能力，火焰容器未命中时会返还一次用量。裂纹弹珠（Cracked Marble）需要弹弓与攀爬，满血时小幅提高伤害。参照图文第 9、10 项。
干涸城堡：银勺（Silver Spoon）需要弹弓和攀爬，尝试治疗时短暂生成护盾。烧焦鞋带（Burnt Shoelace）需要攀爬，全速奔跑时留下余烬。参照图文第 13、14 项。
午夜暴雨与墓谷：蜘蛛网（Spider’s Web）在午夜暴雨，需弹弓和攀爬，可用弹弓射出火焰容器。臼齿（Molar Tooth）在墓谷，需攀爬，滑行时迸出余烬。参照图文第 18、21 项。
秋日森林：在帐篷小游戏里用弹弓击中窄的浅蓝靶，赢得蓝色蝴蝶结（Blue Bow）。受到致命伤时，它会自动消耗一瓶油进行治疗。玩偶头（Doll’s Head）需要攀爬，在石球机关支路抢先上到顶部，向上击球点亮石柱后拾取，可增加攻击距离。参照图文第 19、20 项。
夜之庭园：玻璃碎片无需额外能力，溢出的治疗量会延长临时增伤。参照图文第 15 项。
码头：缠线钉需要攀爬和悬停，让敌人死亡时产生小爆炸。邮票还需要弹弓，未受伤连续击杀时增加货币收益。参照第 23、24 项。
玩偶师之家与沼泽：鸟形纽扣需要攀爬和悬停，低血量时增加货币收益。布片无需额外能力，小幅提高空中攻击伤害。参照第 25、26 项。
蛛网旅店与埋葬墓穴：虫翅需要悬停，并延长悬停时间。余烬瓶还需攀爬，让火焰容器碎裂前迸出余烬。生锈罗盘需要无限攀爬，房间有收集品时会发出提示。参照第 27–29 项。
下水道与猎人小屋：鱼钩需要无限攀爬和悬停，低血量时加快容器补充。生锈叉需要墙壁弹射和攀爬，低血量时小幅提高伤害。参照第 31、32 项。
风化硬币（Weathered Coin）：在拾荒者商店购买，标价 600。装备后，敌人会多掉落一些货币。
拾荒者商店还有四件饰物：银戒指（Silver Ring，800）小幅提高伤害；瓶盖（Bottle Cap，250）让火焰容器弹跳，也用于 Bouncing Bottles 成就；骷髅钥匙扣（Skull Keychain，350）在受伤时迸出余烬；生锈顶针（Rusted Thimble，550）减轻尖刺伤害。以上为折扣前标价。
灵魂归巢奖励：把救出的灵魂送回夜之庭园的鸟巢，按累计交付数量领饰物。归还 2 个得 Tiny Witch Sculpture，治疗时补充火焰容器。归还 12 个得 Pearl Jewelry，受伤时补充火焰容器。归还 20 个得 Paper Clip with String，提高火焰容器的伤害。三件都计入开启女王寝室西门所需的 32 件饰物。
en: There are 32 trinkets from exploration and Looter’s shop; check effects and slot costs before equipping.
1 slot: Spider’s Web.
3 slots: Tiny Witch Sculpture, Bird-Shaped Button.

4 slots: Skull Keychain, Hunter’s Locket, Molar Tooth, Fish Hook, Glass Shard, Pearl Jewelry, Bundle of Hair, Bottle Cap, Glass Eye, Melted Candle, Ember Vial, Doll’s Head, Insect Wing, Hair Pin, Blue Bow, Broken Bell, Burnt Shoelace.
5 slots: Rusty Fork, Nails with Twine, Scrap of Fabric, Paper Clip with String, Weathered Coin, Postage Stamp, Cracked Marble, Rusted Thimble, Rusted Compass, Golden Needle.
6 slots: Silver Spoon, Silver Ring.
Hunter’s Locket: Pick it up in Hunter’s Cabin. It needs no extra ability and gives you a larger window to heal.
Glass Eye: Buy it from Looter in the Save Tent for 450 at its listed price. Equip it to reveal hidden passages.
Hair Pin: In the Bog, bounce on the bubbles in the order they appear to open the barrier. After eight seconds without attacking, your next hit deals double damage.

Burial Vault and Night Garden: Golden Needle surrounds you with spikes below 25% HP. Bundle of Hair sends out embers when you slam the ground. Neither requires an extra ability. See entries 4 and 6 in the reference for room maps.
The Drains: Melted Candle requires Wind Ride and grants two seconds of invulnerability after healing. See reference entry 8.

Graven Valley: Broken Bell requires no extra ability and refunds a Flaming Vessel that misses. Cracked Marble requires Slingshot and Climb, and slightly increases damage at full health. See reference entries 9 and 10.

Desiccated Castle: Silver Spoon requires Slingshot and Climb and briefly shields you while you attempt to heal. Burnt Shoelace requires Climb and leaves embers at top running speed. See entries 13 and 14.

Midnight Drench and Graven Valley: Spider’s Web requires Slingshot and Climb in Midnight Drench and lets you launch Flaming Vessels with Slingshot. Molar Tooth requires Climb in Graven Valley and emits embers while sliding. See entries 18 and 21.

Autumn Forest: Hit the narrow light-blue target with Slingshot in the tent minigame to win Blue Bow, which automatically uses an oil vial to heal you if you would otherwise die. For Doll’s Head, use Climb to reach the top of the orb puzzle branch ahead of the orb, then hit it up into the pillar. Doll’s Head increases attack reach. See entries 19 and 20.
Night Garden: Glass Shard requires no extra ability. Overhealing extends your temporary damage boost. See entry 15.

The Docks: Nails with Twine requires Climb and Hover and makes enemies explode on death. Postage Stamp also requires Slingshot and improves currency rewards for consecutive kills without taking damage. See entries 23 and 24.

Dollmaker’s House and the Bog: Bird-Shaped Button requires Climb and Hover and boosts currency at low health. Scrap of Fabric requires no extra ability and slightly boosts aerial damage. See entries 25 and 26.

Webdrench Inn and Burial Vault: Insect Wing requires Hover and extends it. Ember Vial also requires Climb and makes Flaming Vessels emit embers before shattering. Rusted Compass requires Endless Climb and signals collectibles in the room. See entries 27–29.

The Drains and Hunter’s Cabin: Fish Hook requires Endless Climb and Hover and speeds vessel refill at low health. Rusty Fork requires Wall Sling and Climb and slightly boosts damage at low health. See entries 31 and 32.
Weathered Coin: Buy it from Looter for 600 at its listed price. Enemies drop a little more currency with it equipped.

Looter’s other four trinkets: Silver Ring (800) slightly boosts damage. Bottle Cap (250) makes Flaming Vessels bounce and is used for the Bouncing Bottles achievement. Skull Keychain (350) releases embers when you take damage. Rusted Thimble (550) reduces spike damage. These are prices before discounts.

Spirit return rewards: Bring rescued spirits back to the Night Garden nest. At 2 returned, Tiny Witch Sculpture replenishes a Flaming Vessel when you heal. At 12, Pearl Jewelry replenishes one when you take damage. At 20, Paper Clip with String increases Flaming Vessel damage. All three count toward the 32 trinkets needed for the western door in the Queen’s chambers.

zh: 饰物槽用于扩展装备容量，不等于饰物数量。地图、灵魂归还奖励和商店都能提供槽位。
购入扩容：在存档帐篷打开拾荒者商店，查看可购买的饰物槽。已通关且不急着扩容时，可以先拿女王金币，再回帐篷查看折扣。
秋日森林：用弹弓参加帐篷小游戏。打中金色靶可拿饰物槽；窄浅蓝靶的奖励是蓝色蝴蝶结。可对照图文的饰物槽第 42 项。
深海：解锁鱼雷后回查需要鱼雷的饰物槽。参考图文第 49 项有能力门槛，紧接的第 50 项无需额外能力。具体房间见各条目的地图截图。
墓谷（图文第 20 项）：需要攀爬和弹弓。按参考图中的站位攀到射击点，把火柴射向远处的铃铛，再去拿槽位。
午夜暴雨（第 22 项）：需要弹弓。先把火柴射向最远的气泡，再沿其余气泡依次弹跳过去。
瞭望塔（图文第 35 项）：需要悬停、攀爬和弹弓。把火柴从窄缝射到另一侧，借它当落脚点，再弹跳上去拿槽位。
下水道（第 53 项）：装备玻璃眼可帮助辨认隐藏入口，进暗道拾取需要御风和悬停。
墓谷计时挑战（第 74 项）：起跑时先射出火柴，再跑过前方平台。抵达火柴时借它向上弹跳。末段遇到移动刺球，可稍停等空隙再通过。完成挑战后领取饰物槽。
埋葬墓穴（第 78、80 项）：第 78 项藏在暗道内，无需额外能力。第 80 项需要无限攀爬和悬停。按编号对照各自的房间地图。
参考图文的编号包含商店购入和地图拾取，可用来定位截图。
en: Slots increase equipment capacity rather than trinket count. They come from exploration, spirit-return rewards and the shop.
Shop expansion: Check Looter’s shop in the Save Tent for purchasable slots. If you have reached the ending and can wait, collect the Queen’s Coin first and check the reduced tent prices.
Autumn Forest: Use Slingshot in the tent minigame. The gold target awards a slot, while the narrow light-blue target awards Blue Bow. See trinket slot entry 42 in the walkthrough.
The Deep: Return for the Torpedo-gated slot after unlocking Torpedo. See entry 49. The next pickup, entry 50, requires no extra ability. Each entry includes a room map.
Graven Valley (entry 20): Bring Climb and Slingshot. Use the illustrated firing position to aim the matchstick at the distant bell, then collect the slot.
Midnight Drench (entry 22): Use Slingshot to fire the matchstick toward the farthest bubble, then bounce across the remaining bubbles.
Lookout Tower (entry 35): Bring Hover, Climb and Slingshot. Fire the matchstick through the gap to create a foothold on the far side, then bounce up to the slot.
The Drains (entry 53): Glass Eye can help reveal the hidden entrance. Bring Wind Ride and Hover to reach the slot.

Graven Valley time trial (entry 74): Fire the matchstick as the timer starts, then sprint over the platforms. Bounce off it to gain height. Near the finish, pause briefly for an opening between the moving spike balls if needed. Finish the trial to earn the slot.
Burial Vault (entries 78 and 80): Entry 78 is in a hidden passage and needs no extra ability. Entry 80 requires Endless Climb and Hover. Use the matching room map for each.
The walkthrough numbers both shop purchases and map pickups. Use those numbers to find the corresponding screenshots.

zh: 先在 Looter 商店购买并装备瓶盖饰物，再找帐篷附近的平坦空间练习。
向上抛瓶，保持在瓶子下方，用火柴连续向上击打十次；失败后回帐篷补充再试。
en: Buy and equip Bottle Cap, then practise on flat ground near a tent.
Throw upward and stay underneath, hitting upward ten times; refill at the tent between attempts.

zh: 发生在干涸城堡的女王搜寻段落。避开探照光束，利用房间遮挡分段移动。
被发现会回到检查点；通过整段并触发 Looter 被抓的剧情后解锁。
en: This occurs during the Queen’s search in Desiccated Castle. Avoid the searchlight and move between cover.
Detection returns you to a checkpoint; finish the sequence and Looter’s capture scene to unlock it.

zh: 目标为收齐 32 件饰物，商店出售的饰物也计入。
收尾时检查旅店的虫翅与余烬瓶，以及归还灵魂获得的饰物。
en: Collect all 32 trinkets, including those sold in the shop.
For cleanup, check Insect Wing and Ember Vial in the inn, plus spirit-return trinket rewards.

zh: 条件是把所有可升级饰物升到最高级，不是单纯收齐工坊代币。
逐件检查工坊菜单，预留货币和代币；没有升级选项的饰物无需额外处理。
en: Max out every upgradeable trinket; collecting Workshop Tokens alone is insufficient.
Check each workshop entry and reserve currency and tokens; trinkets without upgrades need no further work.

zh: 推进夜之庭园、沼泽和排水道时顺手清掉沿途普通敌人，累计击杀 100 名。回访收集时可再清沿途敌人，顺便攒购买饰物和槽位的货币。
en: Clear regular enemies as you progress through Night Garden, the Bog and the Drains. The achievement unlocks at 100 total kills. Clear enemies on collectible detours to earn currency for trinkets and slots at the same time.

zh: 先补地图收集和区域回访，沿途的普通敌人也计入 500 次击杀。还差时选帐篷旁有多只容易击败的普通敌人的房间，在回访时清理已经刷新的敌人。
en: Work through collectible cleanup and clear regular enemies along the way toward 500 total kills. If you are still short, choose rooms near a tent with several easy enemies and clear them when they have respawned.

zh: 在猎人小屋取得焰瓶后，探索和战斗时顺手投掷。成就累计的是 100 次投掷，空投也可以。
收尾时找存档帐篷，在附近投完焰瓶，再用帐篷补满，重复到成就解锁。
en: After obtaining Flaming Vessels in Hunter’s Cabin, throw them during exploration and combat. The achievement tracks 100 throws, including throws without a target.
For cleanup, throw your remaining vessels near a save tent, refill there and repeat until the achievement unlocks.

zh: 在夜之庭园击败园丁。耙子从场地两侧飞来时用滑行穿过，砸地冲击波则等它接近再滑。半血后落种与耙子更密，躲完一轮再贴身反击。
en: Defeat the Groundskeeper in Night Garden. Slide through rakes coming from the sides and wait until ground shockwaves are close before sliding. Below half health, evade the denser seeds and rakes before moving in to counter.

zh: 在沼泽击败虫群。虫群聚在头顶时向上打，侧面虫墙出现时借气泡跃过。虫群聚成头骨后，跳过砸地冲击波，再回身打头骨。
en: Defeat the Swarm in the Bog. Attack upward when it gathers overhead and bounce on bubbles to clear walls of bugs. Once it forms a skull, jump over the ground shockwave before striking the skull.

zh: 集齐三个电梯部件，从排水道中央帐篷旁乘电梯进入战斗。首领在头顶时向上打，先处理召出的敌人。她离场后，专心躲上升平台下方出现的尖球，留出滑行冷却时间。
en: Collect all three elevator parts and use the lift by the central Drains tent. Attack upward when the boss is overhead and clear summoned enemies first. When she leaves the arena, focus on dodging spike balls below the rising platform and allow time for slide recovery.

zh: 在午夜暴雨击败七子神龛。中央光束出现时借侧墙攀爬和悬停避开地面电流。追踪电球出现时保持移动，看到粉色光柱就离开，骨臂随后会从标记处伸出。
en: Defeat the Shrine of the Seven Sons in Midnight Drench. Use the side walls and Hover to avoid ground electricity during the central beam. Keep moving when the homing orb appears and leave pink markers before bone arms emerge.

zh: 登上瞭望塔击败星歌者。黑羽弹幕出现后看准空隙滑行，同时留意砸地起手。后半段等攻击间隔再投焰瓶。战后沿路线去拿金色羽毛。
en: Climb the Lookout Tower and defeat the Starsinger. Slide through gaps in the dark-feather volley while watching for the ground slam. Throw Flaming Vessels between attacks late in the fight. Continue onward for the Golden Feather.

zh: 从埋葬墓穴第二处帐篷往左进入战场。看到地面骨刺就跳起悬停，等尖刺消退再落地。散开的骨球还会折返，躲完去程后给自己留出第二次闪避的空间。
en: Enter the arena to the left of Burial Vault’s second tent. Jump and Hover until ground bone spikes recede. Scattered bone balls return across the arena, so leave room for a second dodge.

zh: 在女王城堡敲击封闭竖坑左侧的转轮，落到底后向右进入战场。躲开跳砸落点和贴地危险。带刺滚轮先往两侧散开，再向中央返回，第一次躲过后继续看回程。
en: Strike the wheel left of the sealed shaft in Queen’s Castle, drop to the bottom and head right to the arena. Avoid jump-slam landings and ground hazards. Spiked wheels spread outward before rolling back toward the center, so watch for their return.

zh: 集齐七根金色羽毛进入女王城堡，打过银色玩偶并完成城内救援，再继续到最终女王战。
刺墙收拢、地面长出尖刺时，先跳到升起的平台。看到带碎箭标记的平台，用火柴造落脚点再跳过去。
en: Collect seven Golden Feathers to enter Queen’s Castle, defeat the Silver Doll and complete the rescues before proceeding to the final Queen fight.
When spike walls close in and the floor sprouts spikes, move onto the rising platforms. Use the matchstick as a foothold to cross platforms marked with broken arrows.

zh: 在墓谷推进到处刑现场，打断仪式并击败莉达。战后沿场地继续走，完成艾格伯特的救援剧情后核对成就。
en: Reach the execution scene in Graven Valley, interrupt it and defeat Lida the Terrible. Continue past the fight and complete Eggbert’s rescue, then check for the achievement.

zh: 在码头用三块门石开门，击败深海生物并救出船员。战后继续前进，在篝火处听完船员和 Barge 的对话，取得水上载具使用权。
随后可使用码头水中的载具前往深海。若战斗已经打完却还无法驾驶，先回去完成篝火剧情。
en: Open the Docks gate with all three gate stones, defeat the Creature from the Deep and rescue the crew member. Continue to the campfire and finish the crew member’s conversation with Barge to gain access to water vessels.
You can then board a vessel at the Docks to reach the Deep. If the boss is already down but you still cannot board, finish the campfire scene first.

zh: 取得水上载具后前往深海，深入水下区域并击败虫群聚合体（The Colony），完成针儿与刺儿的救援。
看完团聚剧情，回码头船坞与 Barge 对话取得无限攀爬，方便回收高处的道具。
en: Take a water vessel into the Deep, continue through the underwater area, defeat The Colony and finish the rescue of Thimble and Thistle.
After the reunion, return to Barge at the Docks shipyard for Endless Climb. It helps you reach collectibles above long climbs.

zh: 深入玩偶师之家下层，击败玩偶师之镜，再往西找玛格达并完成救援。
救援后进入附近的能力巢穴，完成教学即可取得墙壁弹射。
en: Descend into Dollmaker’s House, defeat Dollmaker’s Mirror, then head west to find and rescue Magda.
After the rescue, enter the nearby ability nest and complete the tutorial to learn Wall Sling.

zh: 进入存档帐篷，打开拾荒者商店，选一件商品并确认购买。想顺便准备「焰瓶弹跳 10 次」成就，可在瓶盖上架时花 250 货币买下。
更想找暗道的话，玻璃眼原价 450，装备后可以看见隐藏通道。
en: Enter a save tent, open Looter’s shop and complete a purchase. If you are planning to earn Bouncing Bottles, buy Bottle Cap for 250 currency once it is in stock.
If you are looking for hidden passages, Glass Eye costs 450 at full price and reveals them when equipped.

zh: 初到猎人小屋时，按饰物清单第 1 项的房间截图找猎人挂坠。拾取无需额外能力，也无需装备即可计入成就。
如果已经离开小屋，也可在沼泽按出现的顺序踩气泡，打开挡板后拿发夹（图文第 3 项）。
en: On your first visit to Hunter’s Cabin, use the room screenshot in trinket entry 1 to find Hunter’s Locket. It requires no extra ability and counts as soon as you pick it up.
If you have already left the cabin, bounce on the Bog bubbles in the order they appear to open the barrier and collect Hair Pin (entry 3).

zh: 先查无需额外能力的四件：猎人小屋的猎人挂坠（图文第 1 项）、沼泽气泡机关后的发夹（第 3 项）、夜之庭园的发束（第 6 项）和墓谷的破铃（第 9 项）。
到排水道学会乘风后拿融化蜡烛（第 8 项），再带弹弓和攀爬去墓谷拿裂纹弹珠（第 10 项）。归还两个灵魂后，记得在夜之庭园鸟巢领取小女巫雕像。
这条路线提供 7 件，剩下可从拾荒者商店补三件。例如瓶盖、骷髅钥匙扣和玻璃眼原价共 1,050 货币，也可按饰物清单改拿其他地图掉落。
en: Start with four pickups that need no extra ability: Hunter’s Locket in Hunter’s Cabin (entry 1), Hair Pin behind the Bog bubble puzzle (entry 3), Bundle of Hair in Night Garden (entry 6), and Broken Bell in Graven Valley (entry 9).

Use Wind Ride to get Melted Candle in the Drains (entry 8), then bring Slingshot and Climb for Cracked Marble in Graven Valley (entry 10). Return two spirits to the Night Garden nest for Tiny Witch Sculpture.
These pickups give you seven. Add three from Looter’s shop, such as Bottle Cap, Skull Keychain and Glass Eye for 1,050 currency at full price, or substitute other map pickups from the checklist.

zh: 剧情前段可把帐篷内拾荒者商店出售的槽位与沿途拾取一起算。夜之庭园图文第 2 项需要弹弓，第 10 项无需额外能力，可先从后者入手。
看参考图文时按地图截图找房间。图文编号只是该路线的拾取顺序，按自己的进度补满 10 个即可。
en: Combine slots bought from Looter’s tent shop with pickups along the early route. In Night Garden, illustrated entry 2 requires Slingshot, while entry 10 needs no extra ability and is a good early pickup.
Use each entry’s map to locate its room. Entry numbers track the guide’s route; collect any ten to unlock the achievement.

zh: 中期顺路补秋日森林和深海。秋日森林帐篷小游戏用弹弓击中金色靶可拿槽位（图文第 42 项）；深海第 49 项需要鱼雷，第 50 项无需额外能力。
如果离 50 还差几格，再回帐篷查看拾荒者商店，或按位置清单补已满足能力要求的房间。图文第 50 项是路线编号，成就看实际累计。
en: For midgame pickups, check Autumn Forest and the Deep. Hit the gold target with Slingshot in the Autumn Forest tent minigame (illustrated entry 42). In the Deep, entry 49 requires Torpedo and entry 50 needs no extra ability.
If you are a few slots short, check Looter’s tent shop or revisit rooms you can now reach. Entry 50 is the guide’s route number; the achievement tracks your own total.

zh: 击败排水道女士后，看到帐篷入口提示红色感叹号时进去，与 Willow 交谈拿到首枚工坊代币。
在帐篷工坊选一件已有、且有升级选项的饰物，备好界面所示货币和代币，确认完成第一次升级。
en: After defeating the Lady of the Drains, watch for a red exclamation mark at the tent entrance. Enter and talk to Willow to receive your first Workshop Token.
At the tent workshop, select an owned trinket with an upgrade available. Pay the listed currency and token cost and complete the first upgrade.

zh: 秋日森林的节庆路线上，解开第 3 处石球与石柱机关后，进入紧接着的房间。找木车里的节日帽商贩。
同意花 10 货币买帽子，购买时即解锁成就。
en: On the festival route through Autumn Forest, solve the third orb-and-pillar puzzle and enter the next room. Look for the hat vendor in the wooden cart.
Agree to buy the festive hat for 10 currency. The purchase unlocks the achievement.

zh: 在秋日森林击败森林之王即可解锁。战斗场地较窄，首领留在中央，可利用危害之间的空档贴近输出。
尖叶从下方升起时，借两侧墙壁攀爬并悬停转移。后段只剩一面墙，看到尖叶升起就先往那面墙靠。落石砸下后可站到石头上，避开平台上的尖刺。
战后进金色羽毛房，顺路查伊尔达右侧暗道里的玩偶师故事第 3 页。
en: Defeat the Forest King in Autumn Forest. The arena is narrow and the boss stays in the middle, so move in to attack between hazards.

When razor leaves rise from below, climb the side walls and Hover between them. Later only one wall is available, so move toward it as the leaves rise. After a rock lands, stand on it to avoid spikes on the platform.
After the fight, enter the Golden Feather room and check the hidden passage right of Ilda for the third Dollmaker story page.

zh: 旅店老板开始追逐后一路向左。遇到挡板先攻击破障，遇到可破地板就用空中下砸，接着用蹬墙跳、攀爬和悬停过断口。
平台需要切换时先敲铃。遇到小团蛛网，用墙弹把自己向前甩出去，Xbox 手柄默认按 RB。
完成末段长滑铲并回到午夜暴雨，就会解锁成就并获得一根金色羽毛。
en: When the Innkeeper starts chasing you, run left. Attack barriers, smash breakable floors from the air, then use wall jumps, Climb and Hover to cross the gaps.
Hit bells to switch the platforms before crossing. Use Wall Sling on small web bundles to launch forward (RB on Xbox).
Finish the long slide back into Midnight Drench to unlock the achievement and receive a Golden Feather.

zh: 在猎人小屋取到浆果后，回井底见家人。听到响动后跟着剧情调查，猎人的手伸过来时，从井底的洞口跳下。
逃跑途中用普通攻击打破挡路障碍，需要向下破障时在空中按下方向和攻击做下砸，低矮通道用滑铲通过。逃到最下方时解锁成就。
en: Bring the berries from Hunter’s Cabin back to your family at the bottom of the well. Investigate the noise during the cutscene, then jump through the hole when the Hunter’s hand reaches in.
Attack barriers in your path, press Down + Attack in midair when you need to smash downward, and slide through low passages. Reach the bottom of the chase to unlock the achievement.

zh: 从沼泽帐篷往左再往上，借气泡弹跳上去。清完敌人往右，击败下一房的巨型飞虫后继续向右。
到冒泡的水池，将火柴投向墙面。先踩气泡弹到火柴上，再借火柴弹到上层平台。进下一间找伊尔达，露营过场结束、第二天醒来时解锁成就。
en: Go left and up from the Bog tent, bouncing up on the bubbles. Clear the enemies, go right, defeat the large flying insect in the next room and continue right.

At the bubbling pool, throw the matchstick into the wall. Bounce from a bubble to the matchstick, then up to the ledge. Meet Ilda in the next room and finish the campsite scene. The achievement unlocks when you wake up.

zh: 先在排水道学会乘风。从断梯帐篷右侧的风道房继续向右，乘风向右上方走，再下到岔路，选右上出口，找到正在泡澡的青蛙 Willow 并交谈。
继续推进并回帐篷找 Willow。实机记录在躲避女王后回干涸城堡帐篷触发对话。听到开设水疗馆的消息后，地图会标出新目标。
回夜之庭园靠近灵魂交付处的帐篷，一路向左进入水疗馆，即可解锁成就。
en: Learn Wind Ride in the Drains. From the wind-and-spikes room east of the broken elevator tent, go another room to the right. Ride the wind up and right, descend to the fork, then take the upper-right exit and speak to Willow while he bathes.
Keep progressing and check tents for Willow. The recorded run found him at the Desiccated Castle tent after evading the Queen. His spa announcement adds a map objective.
Return to the Night Garden tent near the spirit nest and head left until you enter the spa. Entering unlocks the achievement.

zh: 和靴子里的 Whisper 交谈取得金钥匙，按地图金锁标记开门。墓谷找腿、干涸城堡找手臂、排水道找躯干、沼泽找头。
收齐四件后，地图会标出交付地点。回到接任务的位置拼好拾荒者，领取金色羽毛并解锁成就。
en: Speak to Whisper inside the boot for the Golden Key. Follow the gold padlock markers to recover the legs in Graven Valley, arms in Desiccated Castle, torso in the Drains and head in the Bog.
Once all four parts are collected, follow the new map marker back to the quest start and reassemble Looter. This unlocks the achievement and awards a Golden Feather.

zh: 在夜之庭园可先找《女巫的交易》第 1 页，对照全书页攻略的图文第 1 项定位。拾取后到菜单的故事书页栏确认。
en: For an early page, look for The Witch’s Bargain page 1 in Night Garden. Use entry 1 of the illustrated checklist to locate it, then check the Pages tab after picking it up.

zh: 在菜单核对《瞭望塔》共 6 页。按书内页码依次查夜之庭园、墓谷、瞭望塔两页、深海、沼泽。
漏第 4 页时，带上弹弓、攀爬和悬停回瞭望塔。第 5 页需先解锁潜艇，从深海蜿蜒通道下到底，再从另一侧上浮。第 6 页在沼泽首个帐篷右侧、通往排水道的长隧道，需无限攀爬。
en: Check all six Lookout Tower pages in the Pages tab. In book order, search Night Garden, Graven Valley, the Lookout Tower twice, the Deep and the Bog.

For page 4, bring Slingshot, Climb and Hover to the tower. For page 5, take the submarine down the winding route in the Deep, then ascend on the other side. Page 6 needs Endless Climb and is in the tunnel to the Drains, right of the first Bog tent.

zh: 收齐玩偶师故事的 8 页。按书内顺序查猎人小屋、沼泽、秋日森林、沼泽、玩偶师之家两页、埋葬墓穴、玩偶师之家。
秋日森林第 3 页在森林之王战后的金羽毛房，从伊尔达右侧找暗道。玩偶师之家第 6 页从右侧平台投出火柴，再悬停过去，需弹弓和无限攀爬。埋葬墓穴第 7 页也藏在暗道里。
en: Collect all eight pages of the Dollmaker story. In book order, check Hunter’s Cabin, the Bog, Autumn Forest, the Bog again, Dollmaker’s House twice, Burial Vault and Dollmaker’s House again.

For page 3, look for a hidden passage right of Ilda in the Golden Feather room after the Forest King. For page 6, bring Slingshot and Endless Climb, throw the matchstick from the right ledge, then Hover across. Page 7 is in a hidden passage in Burial Vault.

zh: 收齐《女巫的交易》9 页。按书内页码查夜之庭园、干涸城堡、墓谷、干涸城堡、午夜暴雨两页、猎人小屋、干涸城堡、女王城堡。
干涸城堡第 8 页先用弹弓触发地板机关，沿右侧升柱上升，与左侧横向伸出的尖刺柱齐平时，用火柴造落脚点再跳过去。女王城堡第 9 页需要无限攀爬和悬停。
en: Collect all nine Witch’s Bargain pages. In book order, check Night Garden, Desiccated Castle, Graven Valley, Desiccated Castle again, Midnight Drench twice, Hunter’s Cabin, Desiccated Castle and Queen’s Castle.

For page 8, fire the Slingshot at the floor switch and ascend on the right pillar. When level with the extending spike pillar on the left, use the matchstick as a foothold to cross. Page 9 in Queen’s Castle requires Endless Climb and Hover.

zh: 探索时用火柴击碎灵魂石像，放出第一个灵魂。回夜之庭园，从下层帐篷往左到鸟巢交还，解锁成就。
归还第 1 个会解锁成就，归还第 2 个还能领取小女巫雕像。
en: Break a spirit statue with the matchstick to free your first spirit. Return it to the nest left of the lower tent in Night Garden to unlock the achievement.
The first return unlocks the achievement. Return a second spirit to claim the Tiny Witch Sculpture.

zh: 按灵魂位置清单补到 10 个，回夜之庭园下层帐篷左侧的鸟巢交还。已救出但尚未送回的灵魂需先交付。
交还 10 个解锁成就，想拿下一件饰物珠宝（Pearl Jewelry），还需再送回 2 个。
en: Use the spirit location checklist to reach 10, then return them to the nest left of Night Garden’s lower tent. Freed spirits must be handed in to count.
The achievement unlocks at 10 returns. Return two more for Pearl Jewelry.

zh: 逐区核对全部 20 个灵魂。临近收尾时，优先检查限时挑战的奖励房，挑战成功后还要进门击碎奖励房里的石像。
把 20 个灵魂全部送回夜之庭园下层帐篷左侧的鸟巢。交付后解锁成就，并领取计入真结局前置条件的饰物 Paper Clip with String。
en: Check all 20 spirits by area. If you are missing any near the end, check the Time Trial reward rooms. After finishing the trial, enter the reward room and break the statue.
Return all 20 spirits to the nest left of Night Garden’s lower tent. This unlocks the achievement and awards Paper Clip with String, one of the trinkets required for the true ending.

zh: 击败女王后回战场上方，经拉杆打开女王寝室。把 32 件饰物全部收齐后，打开寝室西侧饰物门。
进门学会腾空（Soar）即可核对成就。继续往里拿神秘标记，用来追踪真结局需要的五枚灵魂碎片。
en: After defeating the Queen, return above the arena and use the lever to open her chambers. Collect all 32 trinkets to open the western trinket door.
Learn Soar beyond the door to unlock the achievement. Continue inside to pick up Mysterious Markings and track the five Spirit Fragments needed for the true ending.

zh: 击败女王后，集齐 32 件饰物开寝室西门，学会腾空并拿到神秘标记。归还 20 个灵魂的饰物奖励也计入这 32 件。
按神秘标记拿齐五枚灵魂碎片。收齐后打开地图，跟随新增目标回夜之庭园原来交还灵魂的鸟巢，观看最后的团聚过场并核对 Together at Last 成就。
en: After defeating the Queen, collect all 32 trinkets, open the western chamber door, learn Soar and pick up Mysterious Markings. The trinket awarded for returning all 20 spirits counts toward the 32.
Collect all five Spirit Fragments. Follow the new map objective back to the original spirit nest in Night Garden, watch the reunion cutscene and check for Together at Last.

zh: 击败女王并看完通关剧情后，回到女王战场上方原先封闭的通道。在锁门旁和拾荒者对话，再敲击天花板上的拉杆打开女王寝室。
进门后调查桌面，拾取女王金币。金币会降低存档帐篷内的购买价格，收尾补买饰物或地图标记前可先来拿。
寝室西侧还有一扇需要收齐 32 件饰物才能打开的门。拿金币时直接查桌面即可。
en: After defeating the Queen and finishing the ending sequence, return to the previously blocked passage above the boss room. Speak to Looter by the locked door, then strike the ceiling lever to open the Queen’s chambers.
Pick up the Queen’s Coin from the table inside. It reduces prices at Save Tent shops, so collect it before buying remaining trinkets or map markers.
The western door inside the chambers requires all 32 trinkets. The coin is on the table before that door.
